name: ‘One repeats just as the...
arabic: يَقُولُ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ المُؤَذِّنُ إِلاَّ فِي ((حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ وَحَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ)) فَيقُولُ: ((لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ)).

transliterations.latin: La havle, ve la kuvvete il-la bil-lah

translations.albanian: Nuk ka ndryshim e as forcë pa ndihmën e Allahut.
translations.english: ‘One repeats just as the mu-aththin (one who calls to prayer) says, except when he says: Hayya AAalas-salah (or) hayya AAalal-falah ‘come to prayer, come to success’ instead, one should say: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah. ‘There is no might nor power except with Allah.’
translations.indonesian: Aku bersaksi, bahwa tiada Tuhan yang haq selain Allah, Yang Maha Esa, tidak ada sekutu bagiNya dan sesungguhnya Muhammad adalah hamba dan utusanNya. Aku rela Allah sebagai Tuhan,
